quote.text: 17. El perseguir imposibles es locura. Y es imposible que los malvados no cometan tales acciones.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Recognize that pursuing overly idealistic or unattainable goals in raising children can lead to frustration; instead, nurture realistic expectations that allow them to grow steadily and purposefully.
  • Parenthood: Understand that even with the best intentions, negative behaviors may emerge if boundaries and ethical guidance are not in place—teach by example to help steer your children away from harmful actions.
  • Leadership: As a leader, avoid chasing impossible objectives for yourself and your team; realistic, well-defined goals foster a culture of genuine progress and sustainable success.
  • Leadership: Maintain vigilance against the inevitable pitfalls of unethical actions by promoting integrity and setting standards that hold everyone accountable, thereby mitigating the impact of 'malvados' tendencies.
  • Product Management: In product development, refrain from pursuing unattainable innovations purely for their ambition; focus on aligning visionary ideas with market realities to ensure feasible, impactful outcomes.
  • Product Management: Clearly define ethical and pragmatic criteria for decision-making, as the allure of radical, risky actions can compromise the product’s value and the team’s integrity over time.
